Yes, well, Matteo, that A7 (A-C#-E-G) is certainly “funky”, but I’m not convinced it fits with the E major key. An F#m7 would give a better progression: A-E/G#-F#m7-B7.

Or, looking at the second part, are you meaning Amaj7 (A-C#-E-G#)?
